stories.headline: Anthropic prices record $81B IPO at $83 a share, valuing AI lab near $1.5 trillion
stories.summary: Anthropic PBC priced its upsized IPO at $83 per share, above the marketed $70-$78 range, raising about $81 billion in the largest listing on record and valuing the Claude maker at roughly $1.5 trillion. Gray market trading pointed to shares opening as much as 27% higher, and the pricing reignited enthusiasm for the AI trade, lifting Nasdaq futures sharply ahead of the debut.

stories.headline: Nasdaq futures jump over 2% as Anthropic IPO lifts AI trade sentiment
stories.summary: Nasdaq 100 futures rose about 2.06%, or roughly 560 points, while S&P 500 futures gained 1.12% and Dow futures added 0.71% ahead of Wednesday's open. The rally followed Anthropic's blockbuster IPO pricing and set up the S&P 500 to potentially snap a five-session losing streak.

stories.headline: Fed minutes turn hawkish as officials eye December rate hike, Waller floats 50bp move
stories.summary: Minutes from the Fed's October meeting showed nearly all officials see further rate hikes as likely needed in coming months, with a few open to a move larger than 25 basis points; Governor Christopher Waller floated a 50bp hike in December. CME FedWatch pricing put the odds of a quarter-point December hike near 95%, with markets increasingly pricing a path toward three consecutive hikes through March 2027.

stories.headline: Dow drops 1.1% in fifth straight loss for S&P 500 as tech diverges
stories.summary: The Dow fell 1.11% to 50,198 and the S&P 500 slipped 0.23% to 7,323.6, marking its fifth consecutive down session, while the Nasdaq Composite bucked the trend, gaining 0.42% to 24,430 as tech outperformed. The divergence came ahead of the Anthropic IPO debut and amid building Fed rate-hike expectations.

stories.headline: Gold sinks to 13-month low near $3,730 as Fed hike bets build
stories.summary: Spot gold fell to its lowest closing level since September 2025 after plunging more than 3% in the prior session, trading around $3,730-$3,736 an ounce. A strengthening dollar and rising Treasury yields, driven by hawkish Fed minutes, made non-yielding bullion less attractive to investors.

stories.headline: Walmart tops Q3 estimates with $188.8B revenue, raises full-year EPS guidance
stories.summary: Walmart reported fiscal Q3 adjusted EPS of $0.65 versus a $0.64 forecast, on revenue of $188.80 billion, beating the $187.27 billion consensus. The retailer raised full-year FY2027 adjusted EPS guidance to a range of $2.84 to $2.89, signaling resilient consumer spending heading into the holiday season.

stories.headline: Target posts 15% EPS growth in Q3, revenue tops $26.4 billion
stories.summary: Target reported third-quarter earnings of $2.04 per share, up nearly 15% year over year, on revenue of $26.41 billion, up more than 4%. The results, reported a day ahead of Walmart's, added to evidence of a resilient consumer heading into the holidays.

stories.headline: Treasury yields push above 5% as rate-hike bets firm up
stories.summary: Treasury yields climbed above the 5% level as traders priced in a higher likelihood of consecutive Federal Reserve rate hikes into early 2027. The move added pressure to rate-sensitive assets including gold and growth stocks, even as AI-related equities rallied on the Anthropic IPO.

calendar.event: Anthropic (ANT) IPO debut on public markets
